recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle, close-up portrait of a smiling man with a beard, wearing a dark navy ribbed sweater, reclining against warm-toned pillows. The composition is dominated by a strong diagonal axis and features minimalist, wide-tracked typography and a thin-line monogram overlay.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal tilt of the subject's head aligns with the angle of the sweater ribs.
The warm orange background pillow contrasts with the cool navy blue of the garment.
The thin red monogram line echoes the warmth of the background while sitting on the foreground texture.
The wide letter-spacing of the name creates a horizontal anchor against the diagonal subject.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face is positioned in the upper right quadrant, scaled to fill approximately 40% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's bright, white smile serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the face down the diagonal line of the sweater to the typography and monogram in the lower third.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left corner (orange pillow) and lower left (sweater texture) provide breathing room for the tight crop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Navy blue (sweater) providing depth and texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange (background pillow) providing warmth and energy.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white (teeth and typography) and thin red (monogram outline).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background orange, low value in the navy sweater, and high value in the skin highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with a graphic monogram element.
graphicDevices: Thin red line monogram inside an elliptical shape
Ribbed fabric texture as a background for text

candidateDirections.reason: Modern, approachable sans-serif with open counters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with a beard smiling, head tilted diagonally, wearing a navy blue ribbed sweater, reclining against an orange pillow. Soft, warm studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a single line of white geometric sans-serif text in the lower third with extreme tracking. Add a thin red line monogram logo in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the head tilted at approximately 45 degrees?
Is the sweater texture clearly visible under the text?
Is the typography spaced widely enough to span the width of the subject?
Is the color contrast between the orange pillow and navy sweater maintained?

postGenerationChecks: Check for clarity of the ribbed fabric texture.
Ensure the white text is legible against the dark navy background.
Verify the diagonal composition feels balanced.
Confirm the skin tones are warm and natural.
recipe.reuseFormula: Close-up diagonal portrait + Textured garment + Complementary color background + Wide-tracked sans-serif text.
